# Solace

Solace is a port of the Zed editor theme of the same name, recorded for both dark and light modes and built around a soft violet palette. Its README documents three variants — Dark, Light and Dusk — selected through Style Settings under Settings, Appearance, Solace, along with pastel syntax highlighting, a styled properties panel, themed tables with alternating rows, and pill-shaped tags in editor and reading view. The README also lists checkbox styling for done, in-progress, question, halfway and canceled states, the last struck through.

![Solace screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bhavya-dang/solace-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Solace"
    author: "Solace"
    repo:   "bhavya-dang/solace-obsidian"
    slug:   "solace"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/solace"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/bhavya-dang/solace-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bhavya-dang/solace-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
}
```
